verses.text: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.
Abram had become very rich in livestock, silver and gold.
From the Negev he travelled from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been at first,
where he had built an altar before. There Abram called on the name of the LORD.
Lot, who was travelling with Abram, also had flocks, herds and tents.
But the land could not support them both while they stayed together. They had so many possessions that they were not able to live together.
Quarrels broke out between the men who looked after Abram's animals and the men who looked after Lot's animals. The Canaanites and the Perizzites were also living in the land at that time.
So Abram said to Lot, "Let's not have any quarrelling between you and me, or between your herdsmen and mine, because we are family.
The whole land is in front of you. Let's go our separate ways. If you go to the left, I will go to the right. If you go to the right, I will go to the left."

Lot looked around and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan towards Zoar had plenty of water, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt. This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.
So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan and set out towards the east. The two men parted company.
Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and set up his tents near Sodom.
Now the people of Sodom were very wicked, and they were sinning greatly against the LORD.
After Lot had left, the LORD said to Abram, "Look around from where you are, to the north and south, to the east and west.
I will give all the land that you see to you and your children after you for ever.
I will make your family as many as the dust of the earth. If anyone could count the dust, then your family could be counted.
Go and walk through the land, through all its length and width, because I am giving it to you."
So Abram moved his tents and went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron. There he built an altar to the LORD.
